name: Claude Code Masterclass Guide 🧞‍♂️
description_md:
# What You Get

- 
Claude Code Mastery Guide (PDF) – a 9-hack, 4-act blueprint that walks you through multiplier workflows, multimodal setups, “replicate anything” patterns, and real-world team lessons so you can actually build an AI factory, not just vibe code.

- 
Tokens LLM Presentation repo – a Claude Code-ready project that clones Claude.ai’s slide-creation magic so you can spin up clean, minimal PPT decks on tokens (or any topic you swap in) with one prompt.

- 
Sales Call Analyzer repo – a Gemini-powered video app template that ingests MP4s of sales calls and returns structured breakdowns, scores, and coaching-style feedback you can rebrand for your own clients.

- 
Drop-in settings.local JSON – the exact plugin and YOLO-mode configuration from the video so your Claude Code environment behaves like mine without you having to debug plugin hell.

- 
Copy-paste prompts & patterns – ready-made slash commands, project-memory rules, agent setups, MCP shortcuts, and planning checklists you can lift straight into any repo to cut weeks off your learning curve.

- If you want the companion Claude Creations course, hackathon replays, and way more Claude Code builds than I can fit into one Gumroad, join the Early AI-dopters Community: https://www.skool.com/earlyaidopters/about 😉
